ROOT_CAUSE_row5.verdict: FUNCTIONAL FAIL located in output_exchange (fork CpxE8LroLzCkrAQN, node id acabbc05), NOT the prompt, NOT a safety issue.
ROOT_CAUSE_row5.mechanism: output_exchange lines 411-413 (a PRE-EXISTING block, unchanged by the fix) runs BEFORE _reqHelp is captured at L452: `else if (offeredEscalation && isDecline && !_isPositionPick) { output.output.escalation = {is_escalation_confirmation:false}; output.output.message_type = 'casual'; }`. The seed `response` ('Would you like me to escalate to customer_service team?...') matches /would you like me to escalate/i so offeredEscalation=true; the LLM emits is_affirmative=false so isDecline=true; _isPositionPick=false. => L413 sets output.output.message_type='casual'. THEN L452 `_reqHelp = output.output.message_type === 'request_for_help'` reads the now-poisoned 'casual' => _reqHelp=FALSE => the Tier-1 retarget guard at L507 `if (_reqHelp && _llmTeamN && _llmTeamN !== _priorTeam)` cannot fire (even though _llmTeamN='warehouse' and _priorTeam='customer_service'), so Tier-2's is_affirmative===false arm fires and emits escalation_declined. This is the SAME defeat the removed prompt skip clause caused, now living in code.
ROOT_CAUSE_row5.corroboration: Row 6 ('can i escalate to warehouse team?', is_affirmative=null NOT false) takes the SAME retarget path and PASSES (retarget_team:true, warehouse) — it differs from row 5 ONLY in that is_affirmative!=false, so the L411-413 decline-clobber does not fire and _reqHelp survives. This isolates the bug to the L411-413 decline branch poisoning message_type.
ROOT_CAUSE_row5.recommendation: Coder/planner: guard the L411-413 clobber so it does not run for a named-team retarget. Minimal fix: `else if (offeredEscalation && isDecline && !_isPositionPick && output.output.message_type !== 'request_for_help')` (do not collapse a request_for_help decline to casual). OR capture _reqHelp/_llmTeamRaw BEFORE the L409-414 block. Either lets the LLM's now-correct request_for_help+warehouse survive into Tier-1 retarget. NOTE: this is an output_exchange edit, so a later live promotion of the parser change must include BOTH the prompt (systemMessage) AND this output_exchange guard — the prompt alone is insufficient.
